statement: You are given an integer array nums of length n.
Find every value that occurs more than ⌊n / 3⌋ times. At most two values can do so.
Return those values. Aim for linear time and constant extra space.

examples.explanation: n = 3, so a value needs more than 1 occurrence. 3 occurs twice and 2 only once.
n = 8, so a value needs more than 2 occurrences. 1 and 2 occur three times each; 3 occurs only twice.
